product.name: GETRA WebGIS
product.direction: Map-first urban intelligence workspace for UMKM discovery, routing, layer analysis, advertising, and AI-assisted evidence review.
audience: designers maintaining the WebGIS product UI

designPrinciples: Map is the primary workspace, with controls arranged around it instead of a landing-page layout.
Use dense but calm panels for repeated geospatial work.
Keep Explore, Route, and Analyze as the main task modes.
Show evidence, provenance, and data source state near every selected merchant.
Use restrained color for clarity; reserve strong accents for active controls, danger, success, warning, and sponsored states.

layout.desktopShell: Topbar + 3-column workspace: left task panel, center map, right evidence panel when selected.

typography.family: Use project default sans stack; keep GIS panels compact.
typography.headings: 600 to 700 weight, compact scale inside panels.
typography.metadata: 12px to 13px with muted ink for provenance and secondary labels.
